title: ObservationProcess
description: Declares how a biological evidence row was generated. A missing row is not a non-detection. Processes that differ must not be pooled with only a source dummy.

process_id.description: Stable id for this observation process definition.

protocol_id.description: Named survey or compiler protocol. Protocols stay separate when detectability differs.

evidence_role.description: PRESENCE_ONLY never implies survey non-detection for unlisted taxa or unsurveyed cells.

nondetection_policy.description: A missing row is not a non-detection unless this policy and supporting effort fields explicitly allow construction.

effort_required_for_nondetection.description: If true, SURVEY_NONDETECTION requires linked completed effort.

detectability_model_ref.description: Pointer to method-specific detectability guidance (e.g. METHOD_SPECIFIC_MODELS.md#rvc).

detectability_variables.description: Names matching DETECTABILITY_VARIABLES.csv variable_id values used by this process.

may_pool_with_process_ids.description: Explicit allow-list. Empty means do not pool. A source dummy alone is never sufficient when processes differ.

pooling_forbidden_reason.description: Required conceptually when may_pool_with_process_ids is empty and multi-source fits are requested.
